usage: Use 福音音樂 as a noun for gospel music, especially in Christian or church settings.
It sounds natural in formal or neutral speech; for everyday conversation, people may also just say 福音歌 or 詩歌 depending on context.
Common collocations include 聽福音音樂, 唱福音音樂, and 福音音樂會.
For learners, remember this is a set term: 福音 + 音樂. Keep the full form when talking about the genre.
